clips.title: The story
paras: In Moonbrook, The Legend of Stalvan leads back to Darkshire's records. A dusty, unsent letter from an old footlocker proves Stalvan Mistmantle stayed there before his trail went cold.

You find a dusty, unsent letter in an old footlocker while tracing Stalvan Mistmantle's past. Moonbrook was once an agricultural settlement, but now lies in ruin, crowded with outlaws and restless specters. Few remember Stalvan's brief stay, yet the letter places him in the hamlet.

You carry the letter across the border to Darkshire, where Clerk Daltry needs it for the town records. He finds it strange that the letter was never mailed, but the evidence confirms Stalvan's connection to Moonbrook. The records can now point toward where Stalvan fled next.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You find a Dusty Unsent Letter in the old footlocker.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, I remember you. You're the one who was asking about that Stalvan fellow. Did you ever find what you were looking for?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Interesting. So the chap did spend some time in Moonbrook after all. It is rather odd the letter never got delivered. Nonetheless, I shall update the registry.
